topic: New dependency mvdan.cc/sh/v3 for parsing shell commands
detail: SP-013 parses Bash tool commands with mvdan.cc/sh/v3 v3.14.1 (pure Go, BSD-3-Clause, the standard Go bash parser; used for its syntax and expand packages only, with command substitution, globbing and ~user lookups disabled). A hand-written tokenizer would be easy to bypass with quoting, $(...), subshells, braces or nested bash -c. Confirm the dependency is acceptable, or ask for a hand-written parser instead.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: keep the dependency; see D-42.
